notes_while_reading.text: The upper abandoned construction uses nonempty intersections of A-circle and B-circle, states a disjoint-union support formula, describes induced equivalence classes as a borne sup, and begins C_k=A cap B. The construction is cancelled; the opening sentence is proposed live from the physical stroke boundary. No claim that C_k is a figure is proved on this page.

A targeted elementary check: for maps f and g on the same set, the fibre of (f,g) at (i,j) is f^{-1}(i) intersect g^{-1}(j). Thus a pair belongs to the image exactly when this intersection is nonempty. This checks only the set-theoretic pattern; identifying the manuscript A-circle strata with those fibres is an additional premise, not established here.

If equivalence relations are ordered by inclusion, intersections of their classes define the meet/intersection of the relations. The literal borne sup in the deleted paragraph is therefore not that order’s join in general. The author’s order convention is not fixed on this sheet, so no textual emendation follows.

The diagrams and lower formula shift between I-prime and J. The image target visibly reads I times J, while the comprehension reads I times I-prime; the pair in that comprehension is (i,j-prime). The box uses j=(i,i-prime) and A_j=A_i cap A-prime_i-prime. These different indices were each reread separately and retained.

The first lower definition has a visible prime on A_i although its preimage uses unprimed phi. The second lower definition has an overwritten capital B|A and a descending j on the left and in the bound. H regularizes both formulae to the boxed construction; the ink does not support that normalization.

The ordinary inverse-image identity (f,g)^{-1}(I_{<=i} times J_{<=j})=f^{-1}(I_{<=i}) intersect g^{-1}(J_{<=j}) follows pointwise, and conditionally explains the intersection in the boxed construction. This does not establish any figure axioms or the surjectivity of the drawn maps.
